title: Intervention.
bodyText: Any person may intervene in any civil action to enforce this chapter if the person has an interest that is, or may be, adversely affected.
bodyHtml: [§342L-12.5]  Intervention.  Any person may intervene in any civil action to enforce this chapter if the person has an interest that is, or may be, adversely affected. [L 1992, c 259, pt of §1]
